_comment: Dev-only seccomp profile for the persistent-mode container. Allows every syscall by default, but makes the Linux kernel keyring syscalls fail with ENOSYS. This forces @napi-rs/keyring to report the keychain UNAVAILABLE, so quick-studio's credential store is created in PASSPHRASE mode (salt persisted to the data volume) instead of the container's ephemeral keyutils keyring — which does not survive a container restart. Not for production; a real deployment would use a keychain that persists.
